notes:
v1.2.0

- Native macOS Tahoe layered icon — light/dark/tinted/clear/glass styling renders dynamically. Older macOS (Big Sur–Sequoia) keeps the flat .icns fallback.
- AI Prompt Samples: new Target dropdown picks ChatGPT (DALL-E 3) or Gemini (Imagen). Gemini variant pushes harder for iconic mascot detail — thick black outlines, gold trim, full prop/accessory rendering.
- Frames mode gains View and Background dropdowns (parity with Single mode).
- Cast spell preset is now pose-only (no glow/orb/particles), so any spell visual can be composited on top.
